properties.name: content-visibility
properties.description: The content-visibility CSS property controls whether or not an element renders its contents at all, along with forcing a strong set of containments, allowing user agents to potentially omit large swathes of layout and rendering work until it becomes needed.

values.name: visible
values.description: No effect. The element's contents are laid out and rendered as normal.

values.name: hidden
values.description: The element skips its contents. The skipped contents must not be accessible to user-agent features.

values.name: auto
values.description: The element turns on layout containment, style containment, and paint containment.

properties.name: view-transition-name
properties.description: The view-transition-name CSS property provides the selected element with a distinct identifying name (a <custom-ident>) and causes it to participate in a separate view transition from the root view transition.

values.name: none
values.description: The element will not participate in a view transition.

properties.name: app-region
properties.description: The app-region CSS property specifies whether an element is considered part of the app's draggable region.

values.name: drag
values.description: The element is part of the draggable region.

values.name: no-drag
values.description: The element is not part of the draggable region.

properties.name: interpolate-size
properties.description: The interpolate-size CSS property allows you to enable animations and transitions between a <length-percentage> value and an intrinsic size value such as auto, fit-content, or max-content.

values.name: numeric-only
values.description: Intrinsic size values cannot be interpolated.

values.name: allow-keywords
values.description: Intrinsic size values can be interpolated.
